# Edit workspace text (workspace.edit)

## categories

[
  "workspace",
  "files"
]

## demonstrations

[
  {
    "expected_output": {
      "bytes_written": 19,
      "path": "journal.md",
      "replacements": 0
    },
    "id": "journal",
    "input": {
      "append_text": "Started a journal.\n",
      "path": "journal.md"
    },
    "title": "Append a line to a journal, creating it"
  },
  {
    "deterministic": false,
    "explanation": "Runs against your own workspace; the file and text must exist.",
    "id": "fix",
    "input": {
      "new_text": "print(",
      "old_text": "pritn(",
      "path": "hello.py"
    },
    "title": "Fix a mistake in a program you wrote"
  }
]

## description

Replacement: give old_text exactly as it appears (read the file first) and new_text; it must occur once unless replace_all is true. Append: give append_text to add to the end, creating the file if needed (useful for logs and journals). The file is replaced atomically. Returns the number of replacements and the new size.
